project: SMIC-Det Original S4 VOC20 Person-14 defense audit

common_contract.scope: metadata-only identity, dimension, label-byte, and decoded-box invariants for pixel-only sanitizers

OP.blocking_reason: The source estimates one class-wise linear direction per classifier class; no principled mapping to multi-instance VOC detection GT has been defined.

AVATAR.blocking_reason: Official pretrained checkpoints/configs are dataset- and resolution-specific; no verified VOC-compatible model/checkpoint is staged.

D-VAE.blocking_reason: The method uses class-conditioned disentangling and two purification stages; a multi-instance condition and VOC-resolution training/evaluation protocol remain undefined.

LE.blocking_reason: The pinned repo is CIFAR-oriented and depends on diffusion checkpoints plus unprotected training data; no authorized non-validation VOC-compatible data/checkpoint is available.
